title: What a Godly Man Does With a Job He Hates (It's Not Quit or Coast)
caption:
What a godly man does with a job he hates. It's not quit, and it's not coast.

Colossians 3:23: whatever you do, work heartily, as for the Lord. Work it like it's for Someone else. Ask what it's building in you. Build the exit on your own time. And quit the griping before you quit the job.

What is one task this week you can do like it's for God?
